recordKinds.0: planned ADCSRA, sleep MCUCR, watchdog WDTCR, ADMUX, DIDR0
recordKinds.1: pre-sleep ADCSRA, ADCL, ADCH, SREG, WDTCR; before watchdog arm and SEI
recordKinds.2: ADC ISR ADCSRA, ADCL, ADCH, entry SREG, ADC ISR count; zero fields if absent
recordKinds.3: watchdog ISR ADCSRA, ADCL, ADCH, entry SREG, watchdog ISR count
recordKinds.4: ADC ISR order, watchdog ISR order, total ISR count, final WDTCR, final MCUCR
recordKinds.5: final ADCSRA, ADCL, ADCH, SREG, total ISR count; before transport
